notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food, Clue or Treasure token.
description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating a Food, a Clue and a Treasure artifact token.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing two artifact tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other token you control using Oltec Matterweaver's trigger, or create Gnomes instead.
